## Houston 0.6.24

### The newest Claude models

- **Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 are here.** Sonnet 5.5 is the new default for everyday work; Opus 5.5 takes on deeper, longer tasks.
- **Claude gets its full 1M-token memory.** Long conversations keep far more context before Houston has to summarize them.
- **A simpler Claude menu:** Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1. Agents on an older Claude model move to the newest one of the same kind.

### Fixes and polish

- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
